definitions.explanation: A product applied to the body to reduce sweating or prevent body odor. Available in spray, roll-on, stick, and sheet forms.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{制汗剤|せいかんざい}が{欠|か}かせない。
{制汗剤|せいかんざい}をスプレーしてから{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I sprayed on some deodorant before going out.

examples.japanese: {無香料|むこうりょう}の{制汗剤|せいかんざい}を{使|つか}っている。

notes: Composed of {制汗|せいかん} (sweat suppression) + {剤|ざい} (agent/preparation). Common types: スプレー{式|しき} (spray type), ロールオン (roll-on), スティック (stick), シート{式|しき} (sheet/wipe type). {汗拭|あせふ}きシート (sweat-wiping sheets) are especially popular in Japan during the humid summer months. Also sometimes referred to as デオドラント (deodorant) in casual speech.
